business_stakes: The paper explicitly links better credit scoring to lower rejection of good SMEs and lower risk for lenders, and says that even small improvements can have significant economic benefits. It also notes that training time is a significant business driver.
business_stakes_quotes: Fundamental improvement to ML or QML could lead to significant economic benefits,
extraction_notes: Motivation is explicit in the introduction and abstract; paper is finance-framed but also strongly algorithmic.
